models_evaluated: AutoGen multi-agent framework with LLM Caller Agent and Dispatcher Agent
unlisted_practices: Grounding LLM agent simulation in a clinically curated taxonomy and fact commons to mitigate misinformation
Hybrid evaluation of simulated dispatch dialogue combining physician ratings, automated linguistic metrics (sentiment, readability, politeness), and operational pacing analysis

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an LLM-based multi-agent simulation system (DispatchMAS) for emergency medical dispatch calls, evaluated via simulated scenarios and expert physician rating, without comparing deployment practices or safeguards.
